property_summary: For any input, the deployed contract's version() returns the major.minor.patch string equal to the constructor-declared version components (1,0,0); the mutant returns 1.0.1, breaking this for all inputs.
change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.0.1".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.1"; }
